coverage: Verified pass on 2026-11-17: every main-list site was fetched live, every feed was fetched and its item dates read, and every affiliation was cross-checked against author-owned pages or Anthropic's own publications. v1.1.0 re-check (2026-11-17): all ten v1.0.0 feeds re-fetched — three changed status (Rieseberg's feed is malformed, Olah's feed returns 404, Carlsmith's feed exceeds focu's 2 MB fetch cap); the changes are recorded in their readiness fields and all sources are retained. This is NOT a complete employee directory — Anthropic has thousands of employees; the pack covers staff whose public, author-owned blogs could be verified. Candidates that failed verification are listed under 'unverified' with the reason, including alumni and collaborators who are not employees.
